caseName: Broadcast Music, Inc. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.
caseNameFull: Broadcast Music, Inc. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc. and American Society of Composers, Authors & Publishers v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 817.] Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time to present oral argument on behalf of the United States as amicus curiae denied. Time allotted for oral argument is divided as follows: 30 minutes to petitioners, 15 minutes to the Solicitor General as amicus curiae, and 45 minutes to respondents.
